BiblicalUsage: Yâlîyd means born, and it is used of the children of the giant, the warriors of Gath who fell before David's men. Sibbechai slew Sippai, and Ishbi-benob thought to slay David himself, but the sons of the giant were subdued.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that giants fall, however they were born, because the LORD fights for His people.
